verdictReason: Two zero-retry runs on the identical exact-main production build disagree. Attempt-1: 11/12 (e2e/customizer-record-sheet-rendering.spec.ts:322 failed). Attempt-2: 12/12. A clean 12/12 exists, but the suite is demonstrably non-deterministic on this build, so R1.browser should not be recorded as an unqualified green.
determinism: attempt-1 failure not reproduced on identical build (single re-run)
determinismNote: Attempt-2 ran on the byte-identical build (BUILD_ID 1789455586707 and standalone server sha256 unchanged, no rebuild) at the same HEAD with the same command, env, port and Node, and all 12 cases passed. Two runs cannot establish a flake rate and a green re-run does not retire the defect: the only proven fact is that e2e/customizer-record-sheet-rendering.spec.ts:322 is non-deterministic on exact main.

attempt2.retainedTraceNote: Zero failures, so --trace=retain-on-failure produced no trace.zip, no error-context.md and no test-failed screenshots. Files remaining under test-results/ are deliberate test attachments only (catalog/recovery PNGs, exported PDFs).

attempt1FailureForensics.preservationNote: Copied out of the worktree BEFORE attempt-2 ran; Playwright's outputDir clean deleted the original directory at the start of attempt-2.
attempt1FailureForensics.failingStep: waitForBacking(page, A4) at spec line 371, reached from line 368 (click tab 'Atlas AS7-D') then line 370 (selectOption 'a4').
attempt1FailureForensics.paperSizeControlQuote: combobox "Paper Size:" [ref=e152] [cursor=pointer]: - option "Letter (8.5\" x 11\")" [selected] - option "A4 (210mm x 297mm)"
attempt1FailureForensics.canvasStateAtTimeout: Canvas backing store remained 2448x3168 (Letter) for the full 10s poll; expected 2380x3368 (A4). Consistent with the control never having settled on A4 rather than with a canvas that failed to re-render at a correct setting.
attempt1FailureForensics.didCanvasRerender: No re-render to A4 geometry was observed. The zoom status read 78% with 'Fit Page' pressed, and the battlemech-record-sheet-canvas testid stayed attached throughout the poll, so the preview was mounted and responsive but never resized.
attempt1FailureForensics.selectOptionOutcome: The Playwright action 'selectOption' with options [{valueOrLabel:'a4'}] against internal:role=combobox[name="Paper Size"i] recorded NO error in the trace, i.e. Playwright considered the selection applied. The DOM nonetheless showed Letter selected when the snapshot was taken 10s later.
attempt1FailureForensics.tabState: tab "Atlas AS7-D" [active] [selected]; tab "Preview" [selected]. The intended unit and tab were correct, so the failure is isolated to the paper-size control.
attempt1FailureForensics.consoleErrors: NOT DETERMINED. The retained trace contains no console entries at all (event types present: context-options, before/after actions, screencast-frame, frame-snapshot, log, input; the only 3 'event' records are page / page / pageClosed for the print popup). Absence of console errors therefore CANNOT be claimed from this artefact.
attempt1FailureForensics.visibleErrorUi: No error alert was present in the failure snapshot. The only alert node is the app live region 'alert [ref=e329]: MekStation'; notably there was no 'Could not open print window' alert.
attempt1FailureForensics.hypothesis: INFERENCE, NOT VERIFIED: a successful selectOption whose value is Letter again 10s later is the signature of the preview's controlled paper-size state being overwritten by an asynchronous re-render/rehydration triggered by the immediately preceding tab switch back to 'Atlas AS7-D', which races the selection and reverts it. This was NOT proven: no console capture, no state instrumentation, and no second observation of the failure exist. It is offered as the lead to investigate, not as a root cause.
attempt1FailureForensics.notInvestigatedFurther: No source was read for the paper-size component, no fix was attempted, and no source file was modified.

followUp: e2e/customizer-record-sheet-rendering.spec.ts:322 is non-deterministic on exact main b39b8291 (1 fail, 1 pass in two zero-retry runs). This warrants a tracked investigation of the paper-size control's behaviour across a unit-tab switch; it should not be closed on the strength of the green re-run.
nonClaims: Native OS printing is NOT claimed. The print tests run against an in-page print harness that stubs window.print and window.open; no OS print dialog, print spooler, or physical/virtual printer was exercised.

Pixel fidelity is NOT claimed. Assertions cover canvas backing-store dimensions, CSS box geometry, aspect ratios, SVG type-field text and PDF page boxes, not rendered pixel appearance, fonts, or visual diffing.
Other browser engines are NOT claimed. Only --project=chromium was run; Firefox, WebKit and the mobile-touch project were not exercised.
Remote CI activation is NOT claimed. This is a local Windows run; no GitHub Actions or Concourse workflow was triggered, modified, or observed.
PDF content correctness beyond header bytes, nonzero size and single-page box dimensions is NOT claimed.
Two runs do NOT establish a flake rate. The attempt-1 failure is confirmed non-deterministic on this build, but its frequency, trigger and root cause are all unknown.

The attempt-1 root-cause hypothesis (tab-switch re-render reverting the paper-size control) is INFERENCE from a DOM snapshot plus a no-error selectOption action. It was not verified and must not be cited as a finding.
Absence of browser console errors during the attempt-1 failure is NOT claimed: the retained trace captured no console entries at all.
Attempt-2's green result does NOT retire the defect and does NOT make R1.browser an unqualified pass.
